notes: Each suite runs the existing checks unchanged; flags listed here only supply what the test sources already require.
concurrency 1 is used where test files share the canonical local PostgreSQL databases or spawn real supervisors.
knownHostRequirements name host facts a suite depends on; absence is recorded as a failure, never skipped silently.

Every test file in the repository is covered by a suite (node-test files globs, or an npm suite's covers list, each of which must appear in that package's scripts) or matched by one exclusions entry with its reason; inventory.test.mjs fails otherwise.

exclusions.reason: immutable historical qualification evidence and candidate snapshots; they are re-run only from their own records, never as package suites
Python qualification-tool tests (proxy, worker image, AWS evidence, host assets); this recipe runs Node suites only and installs no Python test runner or their Python dependencies

reads cdk.out/qualification-checkpoint, which only `node infra/qualification/checkpoint-app.mjs` synthesizes and no package script composes; separate command: node infra/qualification/checkpoint-app.mjs && node --test infra/qualification/checkpoint-security.test.mjs
